verdict.rationale: Substantive guidance text was extracted from the public pages at inpi.justica.gov.pt/Servicos/Marcas and the homepage, covering patents, utility models, designs, marks and post-filing procedures, which implies an agent could reach and read them. The llms.txt probe returned a plain HTTP 404 rather than a challenge page, so the server answered normally. No probe states what user agent was used, rules out a CAPTCHA, or shows the content arrives as server-rendered HTML rather than a JS-only shell, and every topic is attributed to a single URL, so per-page reachability is unclear. Missing for 10: a hands-on probe with an identified user agent showing no bot wall or CAPTCHA, confirmation that the HTML is server-rendered, per-page reachability across the guidance surface, and independent corroboration.
